raw_segments.text: Lear, no, Regan, thou shalt never have my curse.
Thy tender hefted nature shall not give thee o'er to harshness.
Her eyes are fierce, but thine do comfort and not burn.
Tease not in thee to grudge my pleasures, to cut off my train, to bandy, hasty words,
to scant my sizes, and in conclusion to oppose the bolt against my coming in.
Thou better nose to thee the offices of nature, bond of childhood, effects of courtesy, dues
Thy half o' the kingdom hast thou not forgot, wherein I thee endowed."
